about: SaberMapper tier-1 asset library. Every shader is single-pass-instanced and lint-clean; library.md describes each entry in words. Safe ranges are the values the agent may use without extra review; the shader's own Range() is the hard limit.

sm_color_grade.intent: Section-wide mood: exposure, contrast, saturation and a two-tint split-tone.
sm_color_grade.description: The whole view keeps its shapes but changes temperature: shadows lean towards one tint, highlights towards another. Low saturation reads as washed-out memory, high contrast as harsh daylight.

_Contrast.meaning: Distance from mid grey; below 1 flattens

_ShadowTint.meaning: Grey (0.5) is neutral; push a channel above 0.5 to tint the shadows

_HighlightTint.meaning: Grey (0.5) is neutral; tint for the highlights

_Mix.meaning: Blend with the untouched image; animate for fades

sm_chromatic_split.intent: Impact accents: red and blue fringes pulled apart on a hit, then relaxed.
sm_chromatic_split.description: Edges grow red and blue ghosts that separate outward from the centre (radial) or along one direction. Small amounts look like lens fringing; large amounts look like a glitch.

_Amount.meaning: Offset of the red and blue copies in screen UV

sm_vignette.intent: Focus and tension: close the frame in during quiet or ominous passages.
sm_vignette.description: The screen edges darken (or take the edge colour) in a soft oval, drawing the eye to the note corridor. Strong settings feel claustrophobic.

_Radius.meaning: Where the darkening reaches full strength

_Color.meaning: Edge colour; alpha also dims bloom at the edge

sm_glow.intent: Euphoric lift: bright things bleed light during choruses and drops.
sm_glow.description: Bright areas get a soft halo that spreads a little around them; the rest of the image is unchanged. High intensity makes lights look hot and dreamy.

sm_pixelate.intent: Digital or retro breakdowns; degrade the image as a transition.
sm_pixelate.description: The view turns into square blocks; fewer cells means chunkier blocks. Optional posterize reduces the colour steps like an old console.

_Cells.meaning: Blocks across the screen width; below ~40 notes become hard to read

_Levels.meaning: Colour steps per channel; 0 or 1 disables posterize

sm_kaleidoscope.intent: Psychedelic set-pieces in sparse passages; never during dense note streams.
sm_kaleidoscope.description: The screen is cut into mirrored wedges around a centre, like a kaleidoscope; rotating it spins the pattern. It duplicates notes visually, so keep it for breaks.

_Segments.meaning: Number of mirror wedges (integer part used)

_Rotation.meaning: Spin of the pattern in degrees

_Mix.meaning: Blend with the untouched image; keep below 0.7 when notes are present

sm_threshold_dissolve.intent: Stark graphic sections: the image becomes two flat colours, revealed through a burning dissolve.
sm_threshold_dissolve.description: Everything brighter than the threshold becomes the light colour and the rest the dark colour, like a screen print. _Progress eats through the image in noisy patches with a glowing edge.

_NoiseScale.meaning: Dissolve patch count across the screen

sm_scanline_vhs.intent: Nostalgia, tape, surveillance: analogue texture over the whole view.
sm_scanline_vhs.description: Thin dark horizontal lines, rows that wobble sideways, colour bleeding to the left and right, and fine grain. It reads as an old monitor or a worn tape.

sm_radial_blur.intent: Speed and impact: a zoom streak on drops, risers or the moment of a reveal.
sm_radial_blur.description: The image streaks towards a centre point as if the camera lunged forward; the area around the centre stays sharp.

_Strength.meaning: Streak length as a fraction of the distance to the centre

_Falloff.meaning: Radius around the centre kept sharp

sm_sky_gradient.intent: Backdrop colour that carries the section palette; cross-fade between numbered copies at section boundaries.
sm_sky_gradient.description: The sky fades from the zenith colour overhead through a glowing horizon band to the nadir colour below, like dusk over a flat sea.

_Exponent.meaning: Curve of the fade away from the horizon

_Glow.meaning: Alpha written for Beat Saber's bloom; keep low for a sky

sm_sky_nebula.intent: Cosmic, dreamy or vast sections; slow drift under ambient passages.
sm_sky_nebula.description: Dark space with two-coloured cloudy nebula that slowly drifts, and sparse single-pixel stars in the gaps.

_Density.meaning: How much of the sky is cloud

_Scale.meaning: Cloud size; larger is smaller clouds

_Glow.meaning: Alpha written for Beat Saber's bloom

sm_unlit_emissive.intent: Default surface for scene prefabs: rings, pillars, shards and tunnel segments that glow in the palette.
sm_unlit_emissive.description: A flat self-lit colour, optionally with a bright rim where the surface turns away from the viewer and light bands scrolling along it. Looks like neon or light panels.

_BandCount.meaning: Scrolling light bands along UV v; 0 disables

_BandSpeed.meaning: Band scroll speed; flashing above ~3 bands/s is a photosensitivity risk

_Glow.meaning: Alpha written for Beat Saber's bloom

sm_particle_additive.intent: Particle renderer material: sparks, dust, embers and star fields.
sm_particle_additive.description: Soft round glowing dots that add light where they overlap; colour comes from the particle system times the tint.

_Glow.meaning: Alpha written for Beat Saber's bloom

quad.description: Flat rectangle in the XY plane facing -Z (towards the player).

plane.description: Horizontal grid in the XZ plane, facing up.

cube.description: Box with flat faces and per-face UVs.

ring.description: Flat annulus in the XY plane, like a halo facing the player.

torus.description: Donut around the Z axis; thin ones read as neon rings.

tube.description: Open cylinder along +Z; inside=true faces inward, making a tunnel segment around the player.

cone.description: Cone along +Y with a closed base.

shard.description: Double pyramid with jittered facets, like a crystal splinter.
